dialogues.jp: 来てしまった。
dialogues.en: I arrived at the promised destination.
dialogues.text: I arrived at the promised destination.

dialogues.jp: 俺は今、校門の前に立っている。
dialogues.en: I stood in front of the school gates.
dialogues.text: I stood in front of the school gates.

dialogues.jp: 今日は学校は休みなのだが……。
dialogues.en:
It's true that we're right in the middle of school holidays
now...
dialogues.text:
It's true that we're right in the middle of school holidays
now...

dialogues.jp: 昨日、環から電話があって。
dialogues.en: But yesterday, Tamaki called me on the phone.
dialogues.text: But yesterday, Tamaki called me on the phone.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
『巫女部を明日から発足させるのでよかったら
　来てください』
dialogues.en:
"The Miko club will commence activities tomorrow... please
come if you can."
dialogues.text:
"The Miko club will commence activities tomorrow... please
come if you can."

dialogues.jp: と、言われたのである。
dialogues.en: That's what she told me.
dialogues.text: That's what she told me.

dialogues.jp:
電話をもらったからには、やはり行かないのは
まずいだろう。
dialogues.en: With a request like that, there's no way I COULDN'T go.
dialogues.text: With a request like that, there's no way I COULDN'T go.

dialogues.jp: しかし、素直に行くのも何となく気が引ける。
dialogues.en: Although the way she so honestly asked me, felt awkward.
dialogues.text: Although the way she so honestly asked me, felt awkward.

dialogues.jp: 何せ、巫女部だからな……。
dialogues.en:
After all, it's a Miko club, what's that got to do with
me...?
dialogues.text:
After all, it's a Miko club, what's that got to do with
me...?

dialogues.jp:
女の子の妄想はしたところで、実際女の子ばか
りの部に乗り込むのもどうかと思う。
dialogues.en: The whole idea is one centered around girls.
dialogues.text: The whole idea is one centered around girls.

dialogues.jp: 必然性が見つからないではないか。
dialogues.en: It may not be right for a guy like me to be there as well.
dialogues.text: It may not be right for a guy like me to be there as well.

dialogues.jp: どうすっかな。
dialogues.en: What to do...
dialogues.text: What to do...

dialogues.jp: 行かなければ、環はがっかりするだろう。
dialogues.en: If I don't go, Tamaki will surely be disappointed.
dialogues.text: If I don't go, Tamaki will surely be disappointed.

dialogues.jp: しかし、行ったところで、何をすればいいんだ？
dialogues.en: But if I do go, what would I be doing there?
dialogues.text: But if I do go, what would I be doing there?

dialogues.jp: 巫女装束の女の子に囲まれたら、一大事だ。
dialogues.en:
Being surrounded by cute girls in Miko costumes is serious
business.
dialogues.text:
Being surrounded by cute girls in Miko costumes is serious
business.

dialogues.jp:
何が一大事かというと、それはそれで、よくわ
からないのだが……。
dialogues.en: And by serious business, I of course mean in THAT fashion...
dialogues.text: And by serious business, I of course mean in THAT fashion...

dialogues.jp:
休みの学校で、巫女装束の女の子に囲まれてい
る男……それは危険だ。
dialogues.en:
A man, being surrounded by cute girls in Miko costumes, on a
school holiday... that's entirely too dangerous.
dialogues.text:
A man, being surrounded by cute girls in Miko costumes, on a
school holiday... that's entirely too dangerous.

dialogues.jp:
しかし、危険をあえて求めるのも、男のあるべ
き姿なのかもしれない。
dialogues.en:
...But I am a man, and it is a man's place to look for, and
overcome danger, as it appears!
dialogues.text:
...But I am a man, and it is a man's place to look for, and
overcome danger, as it appears!

dialogues.jp: うーん……。

行くべきか、止めるべきか……。いつになく真
剣に悩んでしまった。
dialogues.en:
To go, or not to go... that is the question I seriously
pondered.
dialogues.text:
To go, or not to go... that is the question I seriously
pondered.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「よ、朝倉」
dialogues.en: "Yo, Asakura."
dialogues.text: "Yo, Asakura."

dialogues.jp:
いつでも真剣になることのない男が、後ろから
声を掛けてきた。
dialogues.en:
The voice of the man who's never serious, Suginami,
interrupted my thoughts.
dialogues.text:
The voice of the man who's never serious, Suginami,
interrupted my thoughts.

dialogues.jp: 「よお」
dialogues.en: "Yo."
dialogues.text: "Yo."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「何やってるんだ？　こんなところで？」
dialogues.en: "What're you up to here?"
dialogues.text: "What're you up to here?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「一人で卒業式の練習でもしに来たのか？」
dialogues.en: "You came here to practice for the graduation, perhaps?"
dialogues.text: "You came here to practice for the graduation, perhaps?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「卒業式の練習？」
dialogues.en: "Practice for the graduation?"
dialogues.text: "Practice for the graduation?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「もちろん、在校生代表として俺達を送り出す
　ための練習だ」
dialogues.en:
"Of course, being the one enrolled student presenting the
scrolls to the graduating alumni..."
dialogues.text:
"Of course, being the one enrolled student presenting the
scrolls to the graduating alumni..."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「アホ。俺も一緒に卒業するだろうが」
dialogues.en: "Idiot, I'd be graduating with you all."
dialogues.text: "Idiot, I'd be graduating with you all."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「何、本当か！　やはり暦先生に賄賂を……」
dialogues.en:
"What, how can this be! Your skill at bribery is
unmatched..."
dialogues.text:
"What, how can this be! Your skill at bribery is
unmatched..."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「それはお前だろう」
dialogues.en: "Look who's talking."
dialogues.text: "Look who's talking."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「ほぉ、気づいていたのか？」
dialogues.en: "Oho, so you noticed?"
dialogues.text: "Oho, so you noticed?"

dialogues.jp:
こいつの場合、どこまでが本気で、どこからが
冗談なのかが全くわからない。
dialogues.en:
Whenever I talk with him, I can never tell whether he's
being serious or not.
dialogues.text:
Whenever I talk with him, I can never tell whether he's
being serious or not.

dialogues.jp: 「で、何の用だ？」
dialogues.en: "What did you come for, anyway?"
dialogues.text: "What did you come for, anyway?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「非公式新聞部が入手した魅力的かつ衝撃的
　ニュースを教えてやろうと思ってな」
dialogues.en:
"I received some rather amazing and shocking news from the
"Informal Newspaper Club" yesterday."
dialogues.text:
"I received some rather amazing and shocking news from the
"Informal Newspaper Club" yesterday."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「ま、一応聞いておこうか」
dialogues.en: "You mean the gossip club? ...Well, let's hear it?"
dialogues.text: "You mean the gossip club? ...Well, let's hear it?"

dialogues.jp:
俺に振ってくるってことは、多分環のことに違
いない。
dialogues.en:
Although I asked, there was no doubt in my mind that it was
regarding Tamaki...
dialogues.text:
Although I asked, there was no doubt in my mind that it was
regarding Tamaki...

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「今日は、お前の｛いいなずけ／許嫁｝の巫女部ができるらしい
　な」
dialogues.en: "Your fiancee appears to be starting a Miko club today."
dialogues.text: "Your fiancee appears to be starting a Miko club today."

dialogues.jp: なんだ、そのことか。
dialogues.en: ...Oh, that's it?
dialogues.text: ...Oh, that's it?

dialogues.jp: 内心、ほっとする。
dialogues.en: A wave of relief overcame me.
dialogues.text: A wave of relief overcame me.

dialogues.jp:
ひょっとしたら、もう予知能力のことを掴んだ
のかと思った。
dialogues.en:
I thought they were trying to delve into Tamaki's
future-seeing abilities again...
dialogues.text:
I thought they were trying to delve into Tamaki's
future-seeing abilities again...

dialogues.jp: 杉並の情報力は、侮れないからな。
dialogues.en:
Suginami's surveillance and gathering of intelligence cannot
be underestimated.
dialogues.text:
Suginami's surveillance and gathering of intelligence cannot
be underestimated.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「どんな部か、興味があるだろう？」
dialogues.en: "You would have an interest in such a club, no?"
dialogues.text: "You would have an interest in such a club, no?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「いや別に……」
dialogues.en: "Not particularly..."
dialogues.text: "Not particularly..."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「どうした？　フィアンセが巫女装束を、しか
　も学校の中で着ているんだぞ。行かない手は
　あるまい？」
dialogues.en:
"Why not? It's your fiancee, wearing a Miko costume in
school... surely that pleases your senses?"
dialogues.text:
"Why not? It's your fiancee, wearing a Miko costume in
school... surely that pleases your senses?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「そんなもんかね。でも、やっぱいい」
dialogues.en:
"Christ... although yeah, I have to admit, that wouldn't be
a bad sight."
dialogues.text:
"Christ... although yeah, I have to admit, that wouldn't be
a bad sight."

dialogues.jp: 俺は、あえて興味のない振りをした。
dialogues.en: It'd be lying if I said I wasn't interested in that.
dialogues.text: It'd be lying if I said I wasn't interested in that.

dialogues.jp:
そうしないと、杉並は下手な勘繰りをして、さ
らにややこしい事態になるかもしれない。
dialogues.en: Suginami's too quick to fall for halfassed pretense too.
dialogues.text: Suginami's too quick to fall for halfassed pretense too.

dialogues.jp:
とは言え、この絶好のチャンスを、逃してしま
うわけにはいかないだろう。
dialogues.en:
Speaking of which... this is the perfect chance to ease my
choice earlier.
dialogues.text:
Speaking of which... this is the perfect chance to ease my
choice earlier.

dialogues.jp:
ここは杉並の口から『一緒に行かないか？』と
引き出さねばならない。
dialogues.en: If I could just get him to ask to come along as well...
dialogues.text: If I could just get him to ask to come along as well...

dialogues.jp:
絶妙な駆け引きが必要だ。さてさて、どうやっ
て……？
dialogues.en:
This'd take a perfect amount of trickery and strategy. Now
then...
dialogues.text:
This'd take a perfect amount of trickery and strategy. Now
then...

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「そうか。じゃ、俺一人で行く」
dialogues.en: "I see. Well, have fun."
dialogues.text: "I see. Well, have fun."

dialogues.jp: え？
dialogues.en: Eh?
dialogues.text: Eh?

dialogues.jp: 何だよそれ？
dialogues.en: The hell's that?
dialogues.text: The hell's that?

dialogues.jp: いつもの杉並より、聞き分けがいい。
dialogues.en: This isn't anything like the normal Suginami...
dialogues.text: This isn't anything like the normal Suginami...

dialogues.jp:
ちょっと待て！　これじゃ、作戦が失敗してし
まう。
dialogues.en: Crap, now the mission is a failure for sure!
dialogues.text: Crap, now the mission is a failure for sure!

dialogues.jp:
「いや、お前がどうしても俺と行きたいという
　のなら、ついて行くぞ」
dialogues.en: "N, no, I bet you want to go too, right? Let's go together."
dialogues.text: "N, no, I bet you want to go too, right? Let's go together."

dialogues.jp:
少し、作戦変更だ。ここは『友達を気遣う優し
さ作戦』で。
dialogues.en:
I quickly changed the objective of the mission, to "Let's Be
Good Friends".
dialogues.text:
I quickly changed the objective of the mission, to "Let's Be
Good Friends".

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「気遣いは無用だ。一人で見に行く」
dialogues.en: "Your fears are unfounded. Go by yourself."
dialogues.text: "Your fears are unfounded. Go by yourself."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「ま、待て、友人としてだな……」
dialogues.en: "W, wait, we're friends, aren't we...?"
dialogues.text: "W, wait, we're friends, aren't we...?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「俺も友人に迷惑はかけたくない。一人で見て
　くるから、安心しろ」
dialogues.en:
"I'd rather not be an annoyance to my friends. It'd be safer
for you to go yourself."
dialogues.text:
"I'd rather not be an annoyance to my friends. It'd be safer
for you to go yourself."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「なんでだよ？！」
dialogues.en: "Why not!?"
dialogues.text: "Why not!?"

dialogues.jp: 俺は思わず語気を荒げてしまう。
dialogues.en: My tone raised a few notches at his insinuations.
dialogues.text: My tone raised a few notches at his insinuations.

dialogues.jp: 途端、杉並はニヤリと笑った。
dialogues.en: The obvious show of petulance put a cocky grin on his face.
dialogues.text: The obvious show of petulance put a cocky grin on his face.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「ほぉ、そんなに行きたいわけか？」
dialogues.en: "Hm... you really want to go, don't you."
dialogues.text: "Hm... you really want to go, don't you."

dialogues.jp: しまった！
dialogues.en: Damnit!
dialogues.text: Damnit!

dialogues.jp:
それが、杉並の作戦だと気づいたときには、時
既に遅かった。
dialogues.en: It was too late to stop him from knowing my mission.
dialogues.text: It was too late to stop him from knowing my mission.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「それならそうと言えばいいだろう？」
dialogues.en: "Next time, you could just say so."
dialogues.text: "Next time, you could just say so."

dialogues.jp: 杉並がニヤニヤと面白そうに俺を見る。
dialogues.en:
He flashed those pearly whites at me with that annoying grin
of his.
dialogues.text:
He flashed those pearly whites at me with that annoying grin
of his.

dialogues.jp: 完全に読まれていたわけか……。
dialogues.en: He read me completely...
dialogues.text: He read me completely...

dialogues.jp:
というより、最初から俺は杉並の手のひらの上
で｛もてあそ／弄｝ばれていた感じだ。
dialogues.en: It feels like he was playing me right from the start.
dialogues.text: It feels like he was playing me right from the start.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「では、行こうか？」
dialogues.en: "Shall we go?"
dialogues.text: "Shall we go?"

dialogues.jp:
杉並は勝ち誇った顔で、俺を促すように、肩を
ポンポンと叩いた。
dialogues.en:
With the look of triumph all over his face, he gave me a
slap on the shoulder.
dialogues.text:
With the look of triumph all over his face, he gave me a
slap on the shoulder.

dialogues.jp: 敗北の二文字を背負って、俺は杉並に続いた。
dialogues.en:
With the burden of defeat on my shoulders, I trudged
silently after Suginami.
dialogues.text:
With the burden of defeat on my shoulders, I trudged
silently after Suginami.

dialogues.jp: 杉並と一緒に、特別棟へとやってきた。
dialogues.en: We headed together to the clubrooms.
dialogues.text: We headed together to the clubrooms.

dialogues.jp:
確か、音夢が同好会でも、空いてる部室があれ
ば使っていいって、言ってたよな。
dialogues.en:
It seems Nemu already promised an empty clubroom for Tamaki
to use, thanks to my influence.
dialogues.text:
It seems Nemu already promised an empty clubroom for Tamaki
to use, thanks to my influence.

dialogues.jp:
環が申請していれば、この辺りに部室があるは
ずである。
dialogues.en:
She was probably in the vicinity, handing our
applications...
dialogues.text:
She was probably in the vicinity, handing our
applications...

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「お、あそこにいるぞ」
dialogues.en: "Ah, there she is."
dialogues.text: "Ah, there she is."

dialogues.jp: 俺より先に、杉並がいち早く環をみつける。
dialogues.en: Suginami rushed ahead of me, towards Tamaki.
dialogues.text: Suginami rushed ahead of me, towards Tamaki.

dialogues.jp: 環は、巫女装束姿で、部室の前に座っている。
dialogues.en:
Clad in her Miko outfit, she sat in front of her clubroom,
mulling over a stack of paper.
dialogues.text:
Clad in her Miko outfit, she sat in front of her clubroom,
mulling over a stack of paper.

dialogues.jp: 木の看板に、習字でなにやら書いているようだ。
dialogues.en:
A wooden sign, dictating the club's name, hung off the front
of her desk.
dialogues.text:
A wooden sign, dictating the club's name, hung off the front
of her desk.

dialogues.jp: 「よお」
dialogues.en: "Hey."
dialogues.text: "Hey."

dialogues.jp: 俺と杉並は環の前に立つ。
dialogues.en: I stepped up in front of them.
dialogues.text: I stepped up in front of them.

dialogues.jp: 環は俺達を見上げると、筆を休める。
dialogues.en:
Tamaki looked up at us, her calligraphy brush-holding hand
stalling.
dialogues.text:
Tamaki looked up at us, her calligraphy brush-holding hand
stalling.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「朝倉様。それに、杉並様も、来てくれたんで
　すね」
dialogues.en: "Asakura-sama, and Suginami-sama, you came!"
dialogues.text: "Asakura-sama, and Suginami-sama, you came!"

dialogues.jp: 環は立ち上がり、笑顔で俺達に話してくれる。
dialogues.en: A smile grew on her face, as she stood up to talk to us.
dialogues.text: A smile grew on her face, as she stood up to talk to us.

dialogues.jp: 「ああ、よかったな。部室使えることになって」
dialogues.en: "Yeah. Good to see you got a room to use."
dialogues.text: "Yeah. Good to see you got a room to use."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「はい。これも朝倉様のおかげです」
dialogues.en: "Yes, I couldn't have done it without your help."
dialogues.text: "Yes, I couldn't have done it without your help."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「本当にありがとうございます」
dialogues.en: "Thank you so much."
dialogues.text: "Thank you so much."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「まあ、俺はたいしたことはしてないけどな」
dialogues.en: "Ahhh, I didn't do anything big..."
dialogues.text: "Ahhh, I didn't do anything big..."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「ほお」
dialogues.en: "Oho."
dialogues.text: "Oho."

dialogues.jp: 杉並が俺達を見て意味深なため息をつく。
dialogues.en:
Suginami snickered lightly, the implication obvious in his
eyes.
dialogues.text:
Suginami snickered lightly, the implication obvious in his
eyes.

dialogues.jp: 「な、何だよ」
dialogues.en: "W, what."
dialogues.text: "W, what."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「いやいや、仲が良き事はいいことだなと思っ
　てな」
dialogues.en: "Oh, nothing, just pondering the wonders of friendship."
dialogues.text: "Oh, nothing, just pondering the wonders of friendship."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「これなら、｛めおと／夫婦｝生活に入っても、うまくやっ
　ていけるだろうと……」
dialogues.en: "Friendship so close, you seem like an old married couple."
dialogues.text: "Friendship so close, you seem like an old married couple."

dialogues.jp: 環は杉並の言葉に、真っ赤になって俯く。
dialogues.en: Suginami's words turned Tamaki's face beet red.
dialogues.text: Suginami's words turned Tamaki's face beet red.

dialogues.jp: 「な、何バカなこと言ってんだよ。まったく」
dialogues.en: "W, what kind of stupid things are you saying, idiot."
dialogues.text: "W, what kind of stupid things are you saying, idiot."

dialogues.jp: 俺は照れ隠しに、しゃがんで木の看板に触れる。
dialogues.en:
I could feel the blood rushing to my cheeks too. I observed
the fine wood-crafted sign to take my mind off it.
dialogues.text:
I could feel the blood rushing to my cheeks too. I observed
the fine wood-crafted sign to take my mind off it.

dialogues.jp: 「へえ。これ、環が書いたの？」
dialogues.en: "He-eh, did you draw this, Tamaki?"
dialogues.text: "He-eh, did you draw this, Tamaki?"

dialogues.jp:
木の看板には『巫女同好会』と、墨で書かれた
美しい書体が横に並んでいる。
dialogues.en:
The wooden sign had the words "Miko Association" masterfully
caligraphed onto it.
dialogues.text:
The wooden sign had the words "Miko Association" masterfully
caligraphed onto it.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「はい。やはり、看板は必要かと」
dialogues.en: "Yes. I thought that an appropriate sign would be needed."
dialogues.text: "Yes. I thought that an appropriate sign would be needed."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「ほぉ、達筆だな」
dialogues.en: "Hmm, you have quite a bit of skill."
dialogues.text: "Hmm, you have quite a bit of skill."

dialogues.jp: 杉並が横からのぞきこんで、感心する。
dialogues.en: Suginami, beside me, seemed full of admiration.
dialogues.text: Suginami, beside me, seemed full of admiration.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「やはり、習ペンのミコちゃんで習ったのか？」
dialogues.en: "No doubt, a Miko-chan with a sharp-pen was the artist."
dialogues.text: "No doubt, a Miko-chan with a sharp-pen was the artist."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「ベタなギャグはやめとけ」
dialogues.en: "Don't you ever get tired of those stupid jokes?"
dialogues.text: "Don't you ever get tired of those stupid jokes?"

dialogues.jp: 巫女にミコ……少し、考えろよ、お前。
dialogues.en: Think about it a little, sheesh.
dialogues.text: Think about it a little, sheesh.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「いえ、そういうわけでは……神社ですと、何
　かと筆で書くことが多いもので」」
dialogues.en:
"Not quite... several pieces of calligraphy, such as this
one, are stored at the shrine."
dialogues.text:
"Not quite... several pieces of calligraphy, such as this
one, are stored at the shrine."

dialogues.jp:
真っ正直に受け答えする環も環だが……。ボケ
た杉並が逆に哀れに見える。
dialogues.en:
Returning such a stupid question with a perfectly serious
response... that's Tamaki in a nutshell.
dialogues.text:
Returning such a stupid question with a perfectly serious
response... that's Tamaki in a nutshell.

dialogues.jp:
それにしても、確かにきれいな字だ。環の言う
ように、書き慣れてるのだろう。
dialogues.en:
The calligraphy itself was exquisitely written, obviously
done by someone with lots of experience.
dialogues.text:
The calligraphy itself was exquisitely written, obviously
done by someone with lots of experience.

dialogues.jp:
俺は妙に納得しつつ、実はさっきから納得でき
ないことがあった。
dialogues.en:
Speaking of which, there's something odd here... I should
ask about...
dialogues.text:
Speaking of which, there's something odd here... I should
ask about...

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「ところで、他の部員達は何をしてるんだ？」
dialogues.en: "By the way, where are the other club members?"
dialogues.text: "By the way, where are the other club members?"

dialogues.jp: 俺の疑問を、杉並に横取りされてしまった。
dialogues.en: Suginami beat me to the punch.
dialogues.text: Suginami beat me to the punch.

dialogues.jp: そう。
dialogues.en: Indeed.
dialogues.text: Indeed.

dialogues.jp: さっきから、環以外の部員の姿が無い。
dialogues.en:
All around us, there were no other figures besides Tamaki
and ourselves.
dialogues.text:
All around us, there were no other figures besides Tamaki
and ourselves.

dialogues.jp:
看板を書くにしたって、他の部員がいて不思議
はないのだが……。
dialogues.en:
It's not like this place would be hard to find either, with
the sign and all...
dialogues.text:
It's not like this place would be hard to find either, with
the sign and all...

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「そ、それがその……」
dialogues.en: "W, well, that's..."
dialogues.text: "W, well, that's..."

dialogues.jp: 環はうつむいてしまう。
dialogues.en: Tamaki ashamedly began.
dialogues.text: Tamaki ashamedly began.

dialogues.jp: 「ん？　どうしたの？」
dialogues.en: "Eh? Is something wrong?"
dialogues.text: "Eh? Is something wrong?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「実は……。告知が遅れたのもあって、部員は
　わたくし一人なんです」
dialogues.en:
"Truthfully... as I was late in announcing the club, I am
currently the sole member."
dialogues.text:
"Truthfully... as I was late in announcing the club, I am
currently the sole member."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.en: "Ehh?"
dialogues.text: "Ehh?"

dialogues.jp: あ、そうなんだ。
dialogues.en: Ah, I see.
dialogues.text: Ah, I see.

dialogues.jp: 正直、ちょっと拍子抜けする。
dialogues.en: Honestly, that was... disappointing.
dialogues.text: Honestly, that was... disappointing.

dialogues.jp:
たくさんの巫女服部員に襲われることを夢見て
いた俺は、自分の浅はかさを確認する。
dialogues.en:
My dreams of thousands of Miko were crushed in a single
sentence.
dialogues.text:
My dreams of thousands of Miko were crushed in a single
sentence.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「巫女って、それほどみなさんに知られている
　ものではないのかもしれませんね」
dialogues.en:
"Perhaps, Miko are not an interesting subject to most
people..."
dialogues.text:
"Perhaps, Miko are not an interesting subject to most
people..."

dialogues.jp: と、環は寂しそうにつぶやく。
dialogues.en: Tamaki said in a tiny voice.
dialogues.text: Tamaki said in a tiny voice.

dialogues.jp: まあ、確かにな……。
dialogues.en: That probably isn't far off...
dialogues.text: That probably isn't far off...

dialogues.jp: ちょっと近寄りがたい部分はあるかもしれない。
dialogues.en: It's not a subject that most people are aware of.
dialogues.text: It's not a subject that most people are aware of.

dialogues.jp:
『巫女』という言葉が独り歩きして、実際何を
するのかはよくわからないからな。
dialogues.en:
Miko are destined to walk alone for most of their lives, the
average person wouldn't know or care about them...
dialogues.text:
Miko are destined to walk alone for most of their lives, the
average person wouldn't know or care about them...

dialogues.jp:
「まあ、今は３学期の終わりだからな。わざわ
　ざ入るヤツもいないってだけだよ。来年にな
　れば、たっぷりと……」
dialogues.en:
"It's the end of the 3rd year... there aren't many students
around to join. If you try next year, surely...
dialogues.text:
"It's the end of the 3rd year... there aren't many students
around to join. If you try next year, surely...

dialogues.jp: 杉並も、俺の言葉に同調する。
dialogues.en: Suginami chipped in as well.
dialogues.text: Suginami chipped in as well.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「この学園の子女を、立派な巫女に育てるべく
　発足した部なのだから、ぜひとも頑張って取
　り組んで頂きたい」
dialogues.en:
"I would wholeheartedly support a club aiming to groom our
female students into fine Miko."
dialogues.text:
"I would wholeheartedly support a club aiming to groom our
female students into fine Miko."

dialogues.jp: ちょっと、ずれてはいるが……。
dialogues.en: ...Okay, that's going a bit too far.
dialogues.text: ...Okay, that's going a bit too far.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「……そうですね。お二人とも、ありがとうご
　ざいます」
dialogues.en: "...That is true. Both of you, thank you."
dialogues.text: "...That is true. Both of you, thank you."

dialogues.jp: 環は笑顔になって喜んでいる。
dialogues.en: A smile returned to her face.
dialogues.text: A smile returned to her face.

dialogues.jp:
俺と杉並は、部室の掃除と看板を貼り付けるの
を手伝った。
dialogues.en:
Suginami and I then helped to clean up the classroom, and
attach the calligraphy sign properly.
dialogues.text:
Suginami and I then helped to clean up the classroom, and
attach the calligraphy sign properly.

dialogues.jp:
巫女部の手伝いを終えて、杉並と一緒に校門を
出る。
dialogues.en:
Once we were done with the Miko club maintenance, we left
the school grounds together.
dialogues.text:
Once we were done with the Miko club maintenance, we left
the school grounds together.

dialogues.jp:
「俺が礼を言うのは変だが、ありがとう。助かっ
　たよ」
dialogues.en:
"I know it's odd for me to say this to you, of all people,
but thanks a lot. You saved me there."
dialogues.text:
"I know it's odd for me to say this to you, of all people,
but thanks a lot. You saved me there."

dialogues.jp: 一応、杉並に礼を言う。
dialogues.en: I gave my words of appreciation to him.
dialogues.text: I gave my words of appreciation to him.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「変じゃないだろう。旦那なんだし」
dialogues.en: "It's not odd for you to say as a fiance, no?"
dialogues.text: "It's not odd for you to say as a fiance, no?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「素直に受けとれんのか、貴様は」
dialogues.en: "Just take my thanks normally, bastard."
dialogues.text: "Just take my thanks normally, bastard."

dialogues.jp: 許嫁と言っても、子どもの頃の約束だ。
dialogues.en: Fiancees... that came from our promise as kids.
dialogues.text: Fiancees... that came from our promise as kids.

dialogues.jp:
確かに、ふたりをつなぐ、大切な約束だが、こ
うまで『許嫁』を強調されると、どうかと思う。
dialogues.en:
But more than the promise, it's the "fiancees" part that has
the biggest emphasis now.
dialogues.text:
But more than the promise, it's the "fiancees" part that has
the biggest emphasis now.

dialogues.jp:
俺の記憶が戻った以上、その言葉は俺の胸を、
きゅんと突き刺してくる。
dialogues.en:
Even more important than regaining my memories... that word
thrust itself into my heart, and wouldn't come out.
dialogues.text:
Even more important than regaining my memories... that word
thrust itself into my heart, and wouldn't come out.

dialogues.jp: 「じゃあ、またな」
dialogues.en: "Anyway, I'd see you."
dialogues.text: "Anyway, I'd see you."

dialogues.jp: 俺は杉並と別れようとする。
dialogues.en: I started to walk off, but,
dialogues.text: I started to walk off, but,

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉、ちょっと待て。話がある」
dialogues.en: "Asakura, hold up. I have something to talk about."
dialogues.text: "Asakura, hold up. I have something to talk about."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「ん？　まだ、何かあるのか？」
dialogues.en: "Hm? What's happening now?"
dialogues.text: "Hm? What's happening now?"

dialogues.jp: 何だよ。
dialogues.en: What now?
dialogues.text: What now?

dialogues.jp: 杉並の声に、いつもより重みがある気がする。
dialogues.en:
Suginami's voice had a far more deep and serious tone to it
than normal.
dialogues.text:
Suginami's voice had a far more deep and serious tone to it
than normal.

dialogues.jp:
直感で、何か良くないことを言うのではないか
と構える。
dialogues.en:
My instincts told me that I wasn't going to like what was
coming up.
dialogues.text:
My instincts told me that I wasn't going to like what was
coming up.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「どうやら、俺が推測した胡ノ宮嬢の予知能力
　は、本当らしい」
dialogues.en:
"It appears that my guess of Konomiya's powers of
clairvoyance, was a correct one."
dialogues.text:
"It appears that my guess of Konomiya's powers of
clairvoyance, was a correct one."

dialogues.jp: 俺の歩み足がぴたりと止まる。
dialogues.en: I stopped dead in my tracks.
dialogues.text: I stopped dead in my tracks.

dialogues.jp: ごくりと生唾を呑み込む。
dialogues.en: I took a loud, hard swallow.
dialogues.text: I took a loud, hard swallow.

dialogues.jp: どうしてそれを……？
dialogues.en: How does he know...?
dialogues.text: How does he know...?

dialogues.jp:
そう尋ねたい言葉を、すんでのところで飲み込
む。
dialogues.en:
I wanted to ask straight, but every fiber of my body managed
to keep me from doing so.
dialogues.text:
I wanted to ask straight, but every fiber of my body managed
to keep me from doing so.

dialogues.jp:
俺は、あくまで知らない振りをしなくてはなら
ない。
dialogues.en: It'd be best if I pretend that I still don't know.
dialogues.text: It'd be best if I pretend that I still don't know.

dialogues.jp:
ここで、俺が知っていることを話したら、環の
苦労は水の泡だ。
dialogues.en:
If I let on that I knew about it now, that would just add
more troubles to Tamaki's already overfilled plate.
dialogues.text:
If I let on that I knew about it now, that would just add
more troubles to Tamaki's already overfilled plate.

dialogues.jp: 環の苦悩を、俺は踏みにじることになる。
dialogues.en:
I have to do what I can to keep her from getting hurt even
more...
dialogues.text:
I have to do what I can to keep her from getting hurt even
more...

dialogues.jp: 「またお前、それって根拠あるのかよ」
dialogues.en: "You keep going on about that with no proof whatsoever."
dialogues.text: "You keep going on about that with no proof whatsoever."

dialogues.jp:
俺は努めて、そんなことがあるはずが無い、と
いうニュアンスを作り出す。
dialogues.en:
I did my best to potray ignorance, that I couldn't care
less.
dialogues.text:
I did my best to potray ignorance, that I couldn't care
less.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「まあ、それなりに信用のある情報だ」
dialogues.en: "Perhaps, but I'm confident in the information I received."
dialogues.text: "Perhaps, but I'm confident in the information I received."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「信用？」
dialogues.en: "Information?"
dialogues.text: "Information?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「通常、ニュースソースは明かさないのだが、
　お前は彼女の許嫁だから、特別に教えよう」
dialogues.en:
"It's not your everyday news source. It was how I found out
about your fiancee's powers."
dialogues.text:
"It's not your everyday news source. It was how I found out
about your fiancee's powers."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「何だよ」
dialogues.en: "I have no clue what you're talking about."
dialogues.text: "I have no clue what you're talking about."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「転校してくる前、当時いた学校で、胡ノ宮嬢
　はある女生徒の事故を予知したらしい」
dialogues.en:
"Before she transferred here, she predicted, correctly, that
a female classmate would meet with an accident."
dialogues.text:
"Before she transferred here, she predicted, correctly, that
a female classmate would meet with an accident."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.en: "Eh?"
dialogues.text: "Eh?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「その生徒は、胡ノ宮嬢と仲が良かったらしい
　のだが、本人はそのことを信じなかった」
dialogues.en:
"That student was a friend of Tamaki's, but did not believe
Tamaki's words."
dialogues.text:
"That student was a friend of Tamaki's, but did not believe
Tamaki's words."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「……そいつが、事故にあったってか？」
dialogues.en: "...And then, she met with an accident?"
dialogues.text: "...And then, she met with an accident?"

dialogues.jp:
杉並はこくりと頷き、随分ひどい事故だったら
しいと言った。
dialogues.en:
Suginami nodded gravely. Seems like it was a really bad
one...
dialogues.text:
Suginami nodded gravely. Seems like it was a really bad
one...

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「それまで、予知能力のことは隠していたらし
　いが、事故のことで、学校にも、友人達にも
　知られてしまい、相当責められたらしい」
dialogues.en:
"And with the hidden power revealed, the entire school and
her so-called friends blamed her for the accident."
dialogues.text:
"And with the hidden power revealed, the entire school and
her so-called friends blamed her for the accident."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「なんでだよ。責められる理由なんてないだろ」
dialogues.en: "...How on earth would that be her fault?"
dialogues.text: "...How on earth would that be her fault?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「『知ってて何故助けなかったんだ』というこ
　とらしい。もちろん、女生徒が胡ノ宮嬢の言
　葉を信じなかったのが一番の問題なのだが」
dialogues.en:
Although the girl didn't believe her, the people around her
still insisted that she could've, should've done something."
dialogues.text:
Although the girl didn't believe her, the people around her
still insisted that she could've, should've done something."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「そして、追われるように学校を去り、うちに
　転校してきたという訳だ」
dialogues.en:
"The emotional abuse eventually grew too big, and she
transferred to this school."
dialogues.text:
"The emotional abuse eventually grew too big, and she
transferred to this school."

dialogues.jp:
環のお父さんは、環をいじめから救うために、
転校したのだと、言っていた。
dialogues.en: Her father transferred her here in order to protect her...
dialogues.text: Her father transferred her here in order to protect her...

dialogues.jp: ──どうして。
dialogues.en: ---Why?
dialogues.text: ---Why?

dialogues.jp: いつも、そうなってしまうのだろうか……。
dialogues.en: Why does that always happen to her...?
dialogues.text: Why does that always happen to her...?

dialogues.jp:
本当に環のことを分かってあげられる人は、彼
女の周りには少なすぎる。
dialogues.en:
The people around her who know the truth of her sorrow are
so few...
dialogues.text:
The people around her who know the truth of her sorrow are
so few...

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「あの奇怪な行動も、予知能力を知られずに危
　険を回避しようとするものだったんだろうな」
dialogues.en:
"All of her strange actions can be explained by her need to
hide her dangerous power."
dialogues.text:
"All of her strange actions can be explained by her need to
hide her dangerous power."

dialogues.jp: そんなこと。
dialogues.en: That...
dialogues.text: That...

dialogues.jp: とっくの前から知ってる。
dialogues.en: That, I knew so long ago.
dialogues.text: That, I knew so long ago.

dialogues.jp: 環が、苦しんでいたことだって……。
dialogues.en: The pain that she held within her heart...
dialogues.text: The pain that she held within her heart...

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「ま、胡ノ宮嬢の味方はあまりいないみたいだ
　から、お前には伝えておいてやろう」
dialogues.en:
"Well, I know she has few allies, so you were the first
person I came to."
dialogues.text:
"Well, I know she has few allies, so you were the first
person I came to."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「ああ。助かる」
dialogues.en: "Yeah, you sure saved me."
dialogues.text: "Yeah, you sure saved me."

dialogues.jp: 俺は軽く受け流す。
dialogues.en: I tried to pass it off as a joke, but...
dialogues.text: I tried to pass it off as a joke, but...

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「一人でも、自分のことを解ってくれている者
　がいるだけで、人は安心できるものだ」
dialogues.en:
"It's good enough for me, to know that there's someone who
can help her."
dialogues.text:
"It's good enough for me, to know that there's someone who
can help her."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「……お前にしては、随分まともなことを言う
　じゃないか」
dialogues.en: "...Don't be so direct about those sort of things."
dialogues.text: "...Don't be so direct about those sort of things."

dialogues.jp: 杉並がにやりと笑う。
dialogues.en: That familiar smirk grew on his face.
dialogues.text: That familiar smirk grew on his face.

dialogues.jp: 同時に、俺の中に強い気持ちがわきおこった。
dialogues.en:
At the same time, deep and strong feelings started growing
inside me.
dialogues.text:
At the same time, deep and strong feelings started growing
inside me.

dialogues.jp:
この先、何があっても。俺は環の味方でいよう
という気持ちが……。
dialogues.en:
Feelings of wanting to support Tamaki, no matter what
happens...
dialogues.text:
Feelings of wanting to support Tamaki, no matter what
happens...

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「さて、俺は帰るぞ」
dialogues.en: "Now then, I'd head off."
dialogues.text: "Now then, I'd head off."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.en: "Yeah...."
dialogues.text: "Yeah...."

dialogues.jp: 杉並は俺に背を向けて校門へと歩き出す。
dialogues.en: Suginami turned around, heading back into the school.
dialogues.text: Suginami turned around, heading back into the school.

dialogues.jp: 「杉並」
dialogues.en: "Suginami."
dialogues.text: "Suginami."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「何だ？」
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「……ありがとうな」
dialogues.en: "...Thanks."
dialogues.text: "...Thanks."

dialogues.jp:
杉並はニヤリと笑っただけだった。そのまま、
何処へともなく去っていく。
dialogues.en:
Even if I couldn't see it, I knew he was grinning to
himself, as he headed off to God-knows-where.
dialogues.text:
Even if I couldn't see it, I knew he was grinning to
himself, as he headed off to God-knows-where.

dialogues.jp: わけがわからない奴だな。
dialogues.en: I can never tell what he's really thinking.
dialogues.text: I can never tell what he's really thinking.

dialogues.jp: さて、部活が終わるまで、環を待っててやるか。
dialogues.en:
Hm... club activities should be over by now, I'd wait for
Tamaki.
dialogues.text:
Hm... club activities should be over by now, I'd wait for
Tamaki.

dialogues.jp: やっぱり、帰ればよかったかな。
dialogues.en: ...I should've went back myself.
dialogues.text: ...I should've went back myself.

dialogues.jp: 今更ながら後悔する。
dialogues.en: It's so late now...
dialogues.text: It's so late now...

dialogues.jp:
巫女部は、部員がいない分早く終わるだろうと
踏んでいたのに……。
dialogues.en:
I would've thought that the memberless Miko club would've
been one of the first to finish up...
dialogues.text:
I would've thought that the memberless Miko club would've
been one of the first to finish up...

dialogues.jp:
他の部が帰ってしまった後でも、まだ環が来る
気配はない。
dialogues.en:
But, as I saw all the other clubs pass by and out of the
school gates, Tamaki was nowhere to be found.
dialogues.text:
But, as I saw all the other clubs pass by and out of the
school gates, Tamaki was nowhere to be found.

dialogues.jp:
こうやって校門の前に立っているだけで、何人
という生徒が通り過ぎていった。
dialogues.en:
I'd lost count of the number of students who'd exited the
gates.
dialogues.text:
I'd lost count of the number of students who'd exited the
gates.

dialogues.jp:
授業があるころの華やかしさが無い分、一人で
待っているのは意外に淋しい。
dialogues.en:
Unlike what it looks like in those drama shows, waiting
alone is pretty boring.
dialogues.text:
Unlike what it looks like in those drama shows, waiting
alone is pretty boring.

dialogues.jp:
そう思っていると、環が校門前をやっと通りか
かった。
dialogues.en: Just as I thought that, Tamaki passed by the gates.
dialogues.text: Just as I thought that, Tamaki passed by the gates.

dialogues.jp: 「よお」
dialogues.en: "Hey."
dialogues.text: "Hey."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「あ、朝倉様」
dialogues.en: "Ah, Asakura-sama."
dialogues.text: "Ah, Asakura-sama."

dialogues.jp: 環は一瞬、とてもびっくりした表情を見せた。
dialogues.en: She was surprised to see me still around.
dialogues.text: She was surprised to see me still around.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「ひょっとして、待っててくれたんですか？」
dialogues.en: "Were you waiting the whole time?"
dialogues.text: "Were you waiting the whole time?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「……まあな」
dialogues.en: "...Well, yes."
dialogues.text: "...Well, yes."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「わあ。嬉しいです！　あの、杉並様は？」
dialogues.en: "Wah, I'm so happy! And Suginami-sama?"
dialogues.text: "Wah, I'm so happy! And Suginami-sama?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「先に帰ったよ」
dialogues.en: "He left first."
dialogues.text: "He left first."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「そうですか」
dialogues.en: "I see."
dialogues.text: "I see."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「さ、帰ろうか」
dialogues.en: "Come on, let's go."
dialogues.text: "Come on, let's go."

dialogues.jp: 俺達は並んで歩き始めた。
dialogues.en: We started walking, side by side.
dialogues.text: We started walking, side by side.

dialogues.jp: 「どうだ？　やっていけそうか？」
dialogues.en: "How was it? Plan on continuing?"
dialogues.text: "How was it? Plan on continuing?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「はい。まあ、一人でも何とかなりそうです」
dialogues.en: "Yes. Even if it's by myself."
dialogues.text: "Yes. Even if it's by myself."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「来年になれば、きっとたくさんの入部希望者
　がやってくるさ」
dialogues.en:
"I'm sure you'd get a lot of people wanting to join the
club, when the new school year comes."
dialogues.text:
"I'm sure you'd get a lot of people wanting to join the
club, when the new school year comes."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「そうですね」
dialogues.en: "I think so too."
dialogues.text: "I think so too."

dialogues.jp: 環はそう言って、微笑んだ。
dialogues.en: She smiled along with her words.
dialogues.text: She smiled along with her words.

dialogues.jp:
夕闇の道を二人で歩く。行く手で街灯がポツポ
ツと灯り始める。
dialogues.en:
We walked down the path in the dusk. The streetlights began
to flicker to light as we walked.
dialogues.text:
We walked down the path in the dusk. The streetlights began
to flicker to light as we walked.

dialogues.jp:
道に伸びる二人の影が長く伸びて、トワイライ
トの中でボンヤリと重なる。
dialogues.en:
Our shadows grew longer with the light, the two of us
seemingly in the middle of twilight.
dialogues.text:
Our shadows grew longer with the light, the two of us
seemingly in the middle of twilight.

dialogues.jp:
この｛あいまい／曖昧｝さが……。なんとなく、今の二人の距
離に感じた。
dialogues.en:
In this camaderie... it almost seems like I can feel the
distance between us.
dialogues.text:
In this camaderie... it almost seems like I can feel the
distance between us.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「もう、卒業ですね……」
dialogues.en: "It's almost time for graduation..."
dialogues.text: "It's almost time for graduation..."

dialogues.jp:
不意に環が感慨深そうに言う。どこか寂しげで、
何かを｛いと／愛｝おしむように。
dialogues.en:
She suddenly spoke, with emotion thick in her voice.
Emotions of sadness, love, loneliness...
dialogues.text:
She suddenly spoke, with emotion thick in her voice.
Emotions of sadness, love, loneliness...

dialogues.jp: さっきの杉並の話を思い出した。
dialogues.en: I was reminded of what Suginami told me earlier.
dialogues.text: I was reminded of what Suginami told me earlier.

dialogues.jp:
本当は、前の学校を卒業したかったのかな？
何となく、そんなことを思いついてしまう。
dialogues.en:
Did she really graduate from her last school? It seems
odd...
dialogues.text:
Did she really graduate from her last school? It seems
odd...

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「朝倉様には、学校にどんな思い出があります
　か？」
dialogues.en: "Asakura-sama, what memories do you hold of your school?"
dialogues.text: "Asakura-sama, what memories do you hold of your school?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「思い出ねえ……」
dialogues.en: "Memories, eh..."
dialogues.text: "Memories, eh..."

dialogues.jp: どうせエスカレーター式だからな。
dialogues.en: It's an escalator system, after all.
dialogues.text: It's an escalator system, after all.

dialogues.jp:
卒業と言っても、付属から本校へ校舎が移るだ
けだ。
dialogues.en:
Even though it's technically a graduation, the only
difference is us moving to the main building of the school.
dialogues.text:
Even though it's technically a graduation, the only
difference is us moving to the main building of the school.

dialogues.jp:
一緒にいる友達も変わらないし、特にこれと言っ
た感傷もない。
dialogues.en:
I'd still see all the same people... knowing that, it's hard
to be sentimental about it.
dialogues.text:
I'd still see all the same people... knowing that, it's hard
to be sentimental about it.

dialogues.jp: 「あんまり、意識したことないな……」
dialogues.en: "I don't really hold any special feelings..."
dialogues.text: "I don't really hold any special feelings..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「そうですか……」
dialogues.en: "I see..."
dialogues.text: "I see..."

dialogues.jp: 環は、どうなんだろう。
dialogues.en: What's she trying to get at?
dialogues.text: What's she trying to get at?

dialogues.jp:
と言っても、風見学園に来て、一ヶ月もしない
うちに卒業だから、それこそ感傷なんてないん
だろうな。
dialogues.en:
She herself has only been in Kazami Academy for less than a
month, she can't have any deep feelings either.
dialogues.text:
She herself has only been in Kazami Academy for less than a
month, she can't have any deep feelings either.

dialogues.jp:
むしろ、これから行く本校での生活の方が、思
い出に変わっていくのかもしれない。
dialogues.en:
Better we go to the main school, and she can make real
memories there.
dialogues.text:
Better we go to the main school, and she can make real
memories there.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「わたくしは、どこに行っても、あまり思い出
　が無いので……」
dialogues.en: "Wherever the wind takes me, I never remember much..."
dialogues.text: "Wherever the wind takes me, I never remember much..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.en: "Eh?"
dialogues.text: "Eh?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「転校が多いですから、なじんだと思うとその
　土地を離れなくてはいけなくなりますし……」
dialogues.en:
"I've transferred schools several times, so there's not
really been a place I could call my own..."
dialogues.text:
"I've transferred schools several times, so there's not
really been a place I could call my own..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「ふーん」
何気ない｛あいづち／相槌｝を打ちつつ、ふと不安になる。
dialogues.en:
I made some casual conversational sounds, but deep inside, I
was worried.
dialogues.text:
I made some casual conversational sounds, but deep inside, I
was worried.

dialogues.jp:
転校が多い……。なじんだと思うと、その土地
を離れる。
dialogues.en:
Lots of transferring schools... and no intimacy with the
places she's been to.
dialogues.text:
Lots of transferring schools... and no intimacy with the
places she's been to.

dialogues.jp:
それは、いつか繰り返されるのだろうか……？
ある日……ふと、環がいなくなる日が。
dialogues.en:
How long would history keep repeating itself...? When will
the day be, when Tamaki will no longer be here?
dialogues.text:
How long would history keep repeating itself...? When will
the day be, when Tamaki will no longer be here?

dialogues.jp: 冗談じゃない、と俺は心の中で首を振った。
dialogues.en: This isn't a playing matter anymore, my heart screamed.
dialogues.text: This isn't a playing matter anymore, my heart screamed.

dialogues.jp:
いつの間にか、環が横にいることが普通に思え
るようになっている自分に気づいた。
dialogues.en:
At some point, the thought of Tamaki beside me became the
norm.
dialogues.text:
At some point, the thought of Tamaki beside me became the
norm.

dialogues.jp:
それが当たり前なんだと……。でも、何故なの
か、まだよく解らない。
dialogues.en:
That's certainly what it feels like... even though I don't
understand it myself.
dialogues.text:
That's certainly what it feels like... even though I don't
understand it myself.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉様？」
dialogues.en: "Asakura-sama?"
dialogues.text: "Asakura-sama?"

dialogues.jp:
環が俺の顔を心配そうにのぞきこむ。やべ、
ちょっと顔が険しかったかも……。
dialogues.en:
Tamaki was staring at me worriedly. Damn, I guess I gave
away too much...
dialogues.text:
Tamaki was staring at me worriedly. Damn, I guess I gave
away too much...

dialogues.jp:
「ごめんごめん、何でもないよ。それより、卒
　業式だっけ？」
dialogues.en:
"Sorry sorry, it's nothing. Anyway, how about that
graduation party?"
dialogues.text:
"Sorry sorry, it's nothing. Anyway, how about that
graduation party?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「ええ、卒業パーティーって、どんなことをす
　るんですか？」
dialogues.en: "Ehh? What about the graduation party?"
dialogues.text: "Ehh? What about the graduation party?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「ああ、個人で自由に参加できるから、いろい
　ろだよ。それこそ、露天をやるやつもいれば、
　メイド喫茶をやるやつもいるし……」
dialogues.en:
"Yeah, so many people are participating in it. There's tons
of events, even a maid cafe..."
dialogues.text:
"Yeah, so many people are participating in it. There's tons
of events, even a maid cafe..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「メイド喫茶？」
dialogues.en: "Maid cafe?"
dialogues.text: "Maid cafe?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「…………。ま、行けばわかるよ」
dialogues.en: "......Well, you'd learn when you go there."
dialogues.text: "......Well, you'd learn when you go there."

dialogues.jp:
とても環を『社会勉強だから』と連れて行くと
ころではないが。
dialogues.en:
Though it might not be the best place to bring her for the
"Society Approval Course"...
dialogues.text:
Though it might not be the best place to bring her for the
"Society Approval Course"...

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「なんだか、楽しそうですね」
dialogues.en: "It sounds fun."
dialogues.text: "It sounds fun."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「そうだな。俺も前は、杉並と一緒にバカなこ
　とをやったりして、はしゃいでたな」
dialogues.en:
"Yup. Years before, Suginami and I would go there and play
around a little."
dialogues.text:
"Yup. Years before, Suginami and I would go there and play
around a little."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「そうですか。うらやましいです」
dialogues.en: "I see, I'm envious of the fun you must've had."
dialogues.text: "I see, I'm envious of the fun you must've had."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「まあ、暇なんだったら、卒業式の後にのぞい
　て行ったら」
dialogues.en:
"Haha, if you're free, you could always come down yourself
during the next graduation ceremony."
dialogues.text:
"Haha, if you're free, you could always come down yourself
during the next graduation ceremony."

dialogues.jp: 俺がそう言うと、急に環は黙ってしまった。
dialogues.en: As I spoke, I noticed Tamaki had grown quiet.
dialogues.text: As I spoke, I noticed Tamaki had grown quiet.

dialogues.jp: 何だ？　また俺、変なこと言ったか？
dialogues.en: What now? Did I say something weird again?
dialogues.text: What now? Did I say something weird again?

dialogues.jp: しばらく話さないまま、神社へ続く公園に入る。
dialogues.en:
With some tension in the air, we continued on the path to
the shrine.
dialogues.text:
With some tension in the air, we continued on the path to
the shrine.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉様……」
dialogues.en: "Asakura-sama..."
dialogues.text: "Asakura-sama..."

dialogues.jp: 環はゆっくりと口を開く。
dialogues.en: Tamaki slowly opened her mouth.
dialogues.text: Tamaki slowly opened her mouth.

dialogues.en: "Mm? What's up?"
dialogues.text: "Mm? What's up?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「あの、お願いがあるんですが」
dialogues.en: "Um, I have a favour to ask of you..."
dialogues.text: "Um, I have a favour to ask of you..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「おう。聞けることなら」
dialogues.en: "Let me hear it."
dialogues.text: "Let me hear it."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「…………。朝倉様は、もう誰かと回る約束を
　しているのですか？」
dialogues.en: "...Did you promise to go around with anyone?"
dialogues.text: "...Did you promise to go around with anyone?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「回るって、何を？」
dialogues.en: "Huh? Go around what?"
dialogues.text: "Huh? Go around what?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「卒業パーティーです」
dialogues.en: "The graduation party."
dialogues.text: "The graduation party."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「いや、してないけど……」
dialogues.en: "Well, no, I haven't..."
dialogues.text: "Well, no, I haven't..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「もし……ご迷惑でなければ、わたくしと一緒
　に回ってくれませんか？」
dialogues.en:
"If... it's no trouble... would you walk around the
graduation party with me?"
dialogues.text:
"If... it's no trouble... would you walk around the
graduation party with me?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.en: "Ehh?"
dialogues.text: "Ehh?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「あの、わたくし、この学校の思い出を作りた
　くて、それで、あの……」
dialogues.en:
"I, um, want to make many memories of this school, so I want
to, um..."
dialogues.text:
"I, um, want to make many memories of this school, so I want
to, um..."

dialogues.jp: 環は真っ赤になり、しどろもどろになっている。
dialogues.en:
Tamaki's face grew red, as her speech became increasingly
flustered.
dialogues.text:
Tamaki's face grew red, as her speech became increasingly
flustered.

dialogues.jp: そうだよな。
dialogues.en: Yeah...
dialogues.text: Yeah...

dialogues.jp: 何か一つぐらいは思い出があったっていいよな。
dialogues.en: Even if it's just one, she deserves to remember this place.
dialogues.text: Even if it's just one, she deserves to remember this place.

dialogues.jp: 今この時は、本当に、今しかないんだし。
dialogues.en: For the present, that's all I can do for her.
dialogues.text: For the present, that's all I can do for her.

dialogues.jp: 「ああ、いいよ……」
dialogues.en: "Well, okay..."
dialogues.text: "Well, okay..."

dialogues.jp: 断る理由なんて無かった。
dialogues.en: I didn't have any reason to reject.
dialogues.text: I didn't have any reason to reject.

dialogues.jp:
俺も、環の思い出作りに協力できるなら、それ
はそれで楽しいことだ。
dialogues.en:
Helping Tamaki make memories of this place would make me
happy too.
dialogues.text:
Helping Tamaki make memories of this place would make me
happy too.

dialogues.jp:
それに環は、一緒に連れて回るだけでも華があ
る。
dialogues.en:
And walking around the graduation party with a beauty like
Tamaki by my side...
dialogues.text:
And walking around the graduation party with a beauty like
Tamaki by my side...

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「よかった」
dialogues.en: "That's wonderful."
dialogues.text: "That's wonderful."

dialogues.jp:
環の表情は、張り詰めた緊張の糸が切れたのか、
穏やかになっている。
dialogues.en:
The tension built up in her face was released in an instant,
and she returned to her calm state.
dialogues.text:
The tension built up in her face was released in an instant,
and she returned to her calm state.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉様は、そう言ってくれると思ってました」
dialogues.en: "I knew Asakura-sama would say that."
dialogues.text: "I knew Asakura-sama would say that."

dialogues.jp: え？　もしかして……。
dialogues.en: Eh? Don't tell me...
dialogues.text: Eh? Don't tell me...

dialogues.jp: 「それも予知したの？」
dialogues.en: "You predicted that?"
dialogues.text: "You predicted that?"

dialogues.jp: 俺の質問に環は笑顔で首を振り、
dialogues.en: Tamaki giggled at my enquiry, and shook her head.
dialogues.text: Tamaki giggled at my enquiry, and shook her head.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「いいえ。朝倉様を信じてましたから」
dialogues.en: "No... I trusted in you."
dialogues.text: "No... I trusted in you."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「ウフフ……」
dialogues.en: "Ehehe..."
dialogues.text: "Ehehe..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「そっか」
dialogues.en: "Alright."
dialogues.text: "Alright."

dialogues.jp:
俺もなんとなく嬉しくなった。つい、つられて
笑顔になってしまう。
dialogues.en: Her smile was infectious, and soon, I was smiling too.
dialogues.text: Her smile was infectious, and soon, I was smiling too.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「じゃあ、卒業パーティー、約束ですよ」
dialogues.en: "Okay, it's a promise!"
dialogues.text: "Okay, it's a promise!"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「おう」
dialogues.en: "Yep."
dialogues.text: "Yep."

dialogues.jp:
そうこう言っているうちに、神社に着いてしまっ
た。
dialogues.en: Just as we finished speaking, we arrived at the shrine.
dialogues.text: Just as we finished speaking, we arrived at the shrine.

dialogues.jp: とりあえず、階段を上り、鳥居の下まで来る。
dialogues.en: The bottom of the flight of stairs leading up to it, anyway.
dialogues.text: The bottom of the flight of stairs leading up to it, anyway.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「じゃあ、ここで……」
dialogues.en: "I'd part here..."
dialogues.text: "I'd part here..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「ああ。またな」
dialogues.en: "Yeah. I'd see you."
dialogues.text: "Yeah. I'd see you."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「今日は本当にありがとうございました」
dialogues.en: "Thank you so much for today."
dialogues.text: "Thank you so much for today."

dialogues.jp: ペコリと軽く頭を下げ、環は石段を登っていく。
dialogues.en:
With a deep bow, she started ascending to long stone
staircase.
dialogues.text:
With a deep bow, she started ascending to long stone
staircase.

dialogues.jp: その後ろ姿を見ていると、不意に環が振り向く。
dialogues.en:
As I watched her climb the stairs from behind, she suddenly
turned around to face me.
dialogues.text:
As I watched her climb the stairs from behind, she suddenly
turned around to face me.

dialogues.jp:
環はもう一度、ペコッと会釈をして、そのまま
社務所の方へ歩いていった。
dialogues.en: She bowed once again, and continued her way upwards.
dialogues.text: She bowed once again, and continued her way upwards.

dialogues.jp: 俺は、環の姿が見えなくなるまで、見送った。
dialogues.en: I stood there till I could no longer see her figure.
dialogues.text: I stood there till I could no longer see her figure.

dialogues.jp: ◆巫女同好会設立◆
dialogues.en: ◆Miko Association Beginning?◆
dialogues.text: ◆Miko Association Beginning?◆

dialogues.jp:
巫女同好会を見学に行こうか悩んでいると、杉
並に会う。
dialogues.en:
As I pondered the merits of visiting the Miko Club, I bumped
into Suginami.
dialogues.text:
As I pondered the merits of visiting the Miko Club, I bumped
into Suginami.

dialogues.jp:
杉並は同好会に興味があるらしく、一緒に見学
へ行こうと誘ってくる。
dialogues.en:
He was interested in the club as well, so I invited him to
check it out with me.
dialogues.text:
He was interested in the club as well, so I invited him to
check it out with me.

dialogues.jp:
二人で様子を見に行くと、部員は環一人しかい
なかった。
dialogues.en: When we went there though, Tamaki was the only person there.
dialogues.text: When we went there though, Tamaki was the only person there.

dialogues.jp:
杉並が環の予知能力は本物であるという情報を
持ってくる。前の学校でいざこざがあったらし
い。
dialogues.en:
Suginami later revealed his intelligence on Tamaki's real
powers. Apparently she had trouble in her previous school.
dialogues.text:
Suginami later revealed his intelligence on Tamaki's real
powers. Apparently she had trouble in her previous school.

dialogues.jp:
杉並は、俺にたった一人の味方でも、心強いも
のだと話す。
dialogues.en:
Suginami's belief in me being able to help her out, made my
resolve stronger.
dialogues.text:
Suginami's belief in me being able to help her out, made my
resolve stronger.

dialogues.jp:
そして、俺は環の部活が終わるまで、校門で待っ
ていた。
dialogues.en:
So, I awaited the ending of club activities, and waited for
her at the school gates.
dialogues.text:
So, I awaited the ending of club activities, and waited for
her at the school gates.

dialogues.jp:
話をしながら帰ると、卒業パーティーの話にな
り、環に一緒に回らないかと誘われる。
dialogues.en:
While talking on the way home, the subject turned to the
Graduation Party, and Tamaki asked whether we could look
around it together.
dialogues.text:
While talking on the way home, the subject turned to the
Graduation Party, and Tamaki asked whether we could look
around it together.

dialogues.jp:
付属最後の思い出作りができるなら、それもま
あいいだろう。
dialogues.en:
I agreed, if only so she could have something to remember
this school by.
dialogues.text:
I agreed, if only so she could have something to remember
this school by.
